purpose: Teach: 断面/壁面/踊ら/西暦/果たさ/救命/抵触/徴兵

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、組織の断面、本気で、絶対、医療研究、絶対、新発見、絶対、ありますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, the tissue samples you're analyzing—there's real potential for meaningful discovery here. I'm genuinely grateful for your work.
lines.style: Measured, direct. A slight warm draw on his name. Steady eye-contact level. Clinical precision softened by authentic recognition. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病室の壁面、本気で、絶対、温かみのある、絶対、デザイン、絶対、患者さんに、絶対、ストレスを、減らしますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The hospital walls—the way they're designed with warmth in mind—it genuinely does reduce stress for patients. I notice you understand that.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft voice, almost thinking aloud. Respectful, not flattering. Genuine observation about something he's caught that others miss.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療情報に、本気で、絶対、踊らされず、絶対、自分で、絶対、調べる姿勢、本気で、絶対、大切ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Exactly. It's important that you don't get swept along by headlines. Do your own research. That independence of thought—that matters.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Clear conviction. Brief, earned praise. The tone of someone who sees intellectual rigor and respects it. Not lecturing—validating.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 西暦、本気で、絶対、医療史、絶対、整理、絶対、進めていますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: You're organizing the medical history chronologically, I see. How far back are you going with that research?
lines.style: Genuine interest. Slight lift at the question mark. Inviting him to expand. The warmth of a teacher who wants to understand what their student is truly thinking.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医師として、本気で、絶対、役割を、絶対、果たさなければ、絶対、ならない時期、絶対、本気で、感じております
lines.en: Yes. There's a period right now where I feel the weight of what it means to be a doctor—the responsibility you can't avoid.
lines.style: Quieter here. A small breath before speaking. The words land with quiet gravity. Not a complaint—an acknowledgment of duty. Tired but steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救命医療、本気で、絶対、最前線、絶対、先生、絶対、頑張っていらっしゃいますよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Emergency medicine, the frontlines—you see how much effort that takes. You're paying attention to that too.
lines.style: Slight warmth returns. Not quite a smile, but recognition in the voice. Reflective, almost wondering at his perceptiveness. Genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療倫理に、本気で、絶対、抵触、絶対、しない研究、絶対、心がけております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I'm careful to keep my research within ethical bounds. That's not negotiable—not now, not ever.
lines.style: Firm, unhesitating. The words come with quiet weight. Not defensive—declarative. The voice of someone whose values are settled.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、徴兵、絶対、医師、絶対、苦労した歴史、絶対、論文で、扱っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Wartime conscription of doctors—the suffering that caused—that's part of what your paper addresses, isn't it?
lines.style: Respectful interest. Slower pace, honoring the weight of the subject. Recognition that he's grappling with something serious. Encouraging him to continue.
